plan.summary: PKT-12 Review Rescue AI Faz 3: Follow-up scheduler — RescueFollowUpService (IHostedService, 4h timer), T+24h satisfaction check, T+48h review redirect with keyword-based positive response detection. Marketing endpoints for follow-up due query and status update. Migration 008 for followup_status column.
plan.q_intent: PKT-12 Faz 3: Kurtarma mesajı sonrası takip sistemi. 24 saat sonra memnuniyet sorgusu, olumlu ise 48 saat sonra yorum yönlendirme. Tenant settings'ten review_url.
plan.interview_notes: Full stack (Marketing + Automation). Keyword-based response detection (Turkish). Tenant settings_json'dan review_url. Mevcut CronSchedulerService pattern'i takip eden ayrı IHostedService.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: RescueFollowUpService runs as IHostedService with 4h timer interval, follows CronSchedulerService guard pattern (Interlocked, typed catches)
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: RescueFollowUpService: IHostedService+IDisposable, 4h timer, Interlocked guard, typed catches (OperationCanceledException, HttpRequestException, NpgsqlException)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: T+24h satisfaction check: queries rescued risks with followup_status='none' older than 24h, sends satisfaction message via Outbound
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: GetFollowUpDueRisksAsync SQL: rescue_status='rescued' AND followup_status='none' AND updated_at < NOW()-24h. SendSatisfactionCheckAsync sends via OutboundRescueClient

acceptance_criteria.criterion: T+48h review redirect: queries risks with followup_status='satisfaction_sent' and customer_response='satisfied', sends review URL from tenant settings
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: SQL Stage 2 condition + GetTenantReviewUrlAsync reads review_url from settings_json. Sends redirect message with URL

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Keyword-based positive response detection with 20+ Turkish positive keywords
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: RescueFollowUpService.IsPositiveResponse: 20 Turkish keywords (evet, teşekkür, memnunum, güzel, etc.)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Marketing endpoints: GET /rescue/risks/followup-due (cross-tenant batch) and PUT /rescue/risks/{id}/followup with validation
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: Marketing Program.cs: 2 new endpoints + endpoint registry entries. PUT validates followup_status values

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Migration 008 adds followup_status and followup_sent_at columns with constraint and partial index
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: 008-rescue-followup.sql: ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS, CHECK constraint (5 valid values), partial index WHERE rescue_status='rescued'

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Error codes INV-AT-055 and INV-AT-056 defined and used in all follow-up error paths
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: ErrorCodes.cs: 055+056 defined. Used in RescueFollowUpService (query+send), MarketingRescueClient (followup methods)

files_changed.change: NEW: IHostedService, 4h timer, T+24h satisfaction + T+48h review redirect + keyword positive detection
NEW: Migration for followup_status + followup_sent_at columns + partial index
Added GetFollowUpDueRisksAsync, UpdateFollowUpStatusAsync, UpdateCustomerResponseAsync + FollowUpDueItem DTO
GET /rescue/risks/followup-due + PUT /rescue/risks/{id}/followup endpoints + FollowUpUpdateRequest DTO + endpoint registry
DDL updated: followup_status + followup_sent_at columns + constraint + index

verification_questions.question: Does the follow-up due query correctly separate Stage 1 (T+24h, none→satisfaction_sent) from Stage 2 (T+48h, satisfaction_sent+satisfied→review_redirect)?
Is the GET /rescue/risks/followup-due endpoint intentionally cross-tenant for batch processing, and is this safe without JWT?
Does RescueFollowUpService handle all error paths (Marketing unreachable, Outbound unreachable, no review_url) without crashing the timer loop?
Are all typed catch blocks in the new code using specific error codes with logging (no silent failures)?

intentional_exclusions: Response detection hook in AutomationOrchestrator (requires separate integration point)

error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: All catch blocks use INV-AT-055/056 error codes with logging. Follow-up failure never blocks main chat flow — background job retries next 4h cycle.
